mcqs.question_en: What is the monthly financial assistance provided to eligible women under Mahtari Vandan Yojana in Chhattisgarh?
mcqs.question_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ में महतारी वंदन योजना के तहत पात्र महिलाओं को प्रति माह कितनी वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है?
mcqs.explanation_en: Eligible women receive ₹1,000 per month, totaling ₹12,000 annually.
mcqs.explanation_hi: योजना के तहत प्रति माह ₹1,000 (सालाना ₹12,000) दिए जाते हैं।

mcqs.question_en: What is the minimum eligibility age for married women to receive benefits under the scheme?
mcqs.question_hi: महतारी वंदन योजना के तहत लाभ प्राप्त करने के लिए विवाहित महिलाओं की न्यूनतम आयु सीमा क्या है?
mcqs.explanation_en: Women must have attained 21 years of age as of 1 January of the application year.
mcqs.explanation_hi: पात्रता हेतु महिला की आयु 21 वर्ष या उससे अधिक होनी चाहिए।

mcqs.question_en: Which state government department serves as the nodal implementing authority for Mahtari Vandan Yojana?
mcqs.question_hi: महतारी वंदन योजना का संचालन करने वाला राज्य का नोडल विभाग कौन सा है?
mcqs.explanation_en: The Women and Child Development Department of Chhattisgarh implements the scheme.
mcqs.explanation_hi: महिला एवं बाल विकास विभाग इस योजना की नोडल क्रियान्वयन संस्था है।

mcqs.question_en: In which year was Mahtari Vandan Yojana launched in Chhattisgarh?
mcqs.question_hi: छत्तीसगढ़ में महतारी वंदन योजना का शुभारंभ किस वर्ष किया गया था?
mcqs.explanation_en: The scheme was launched in 2024.
mcqs.explanation_hi: यह योजना वर्ष 2024 में शुरू की गई थी।

mcqs.question_en: What mode of financial transfer is utilized to disburse funds to beneficiaries under the scheme?
mcqs.question_hi: योजना के तहत लाभार्थियों को राशि वितरित करने के लिए किस वित्तीय अंतरण प्रणाली का उपयोग किया जाता है?
options_en: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to bank accounts
options_hi: बैंक खातों में प्रत्यक्ष लाभ अंतरण (DBT)
mcqs.explanation_en: Assistance is credited electronically via DBT into individual bank accounts.
mcqs.explanation_hi: यह सहायता राशि सीधे बैंक खातों में डीबीटी (DBT) द्वारा अंतरित की जाती है।

intelligence.history_en: Inaugurated in early 2024 to enhance household financial autonomy among women.
keyFacts_en: Financial Benefit: ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 per year)
Eligible Beneficiaries: Married women aged 21 and above residing in CG
Disbursement Mode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to bank accounts

articles.summary: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully carried out consecutive flight tests of the 4th-generation Very Short Range Air Defence System (VSHORADS) from the Integrated Test Range (ITR) in Chandipur off the coast of Odisha. mcqs.question_en: What propulsion system is integrated into the VSHORADS missile for rapid launch and intercept?
mcqs.question_hi: त्वरित उड़ान और मारक क्षमता हेतु VSHORADS मिसाइल में कौन सी प्रणोदन प्रणाली लगाई गई है?

mcqs.question_hi: सैनिकों द्वारा कंधे पर रखकर दागे जाने वाले मिसाइल सिस्टम को किस श्रेणी में रखा जाता है?
mcqs.explanation_en: Portable systems operated by individuals or crews are called MANPADS.
mcqs.explanation_hi: कंधे से दागी जाने वाली प्रणालियों को MANPADS (Man-Portable Air Defence System) कहा जाता है।

articles.summary: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) achieved operational readiness across 95% of the Western and Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridors (DFC), spanning over 2,700 route kilometres. Operating long-haul heavy-axle freight trains at speeds up to 100 km/h, the network has drastically slashed cargo transit times between industrial hubs in northern India and maritime ports in Gujarat and Maharashtra.

mcqs.question_en: Which public sector enterprise under the Ministry of Railways is executing the Dedicated Freight Corridor project?

mcqs.explanation_en: DFCCIL (Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited) executes the DFCs.
mcqs.explanation_hi: डीएफसीसीआईएल (DFCCIL) इस परियोजना का निर्माण और परिचालन करता है।

mcqs.question_en: Where does the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (WDFC) terminate in Maharashtra?
mcqs.question_hi: वेस्टर्न डेडिकेटेड फ्रेट कॉरिडोर (WDFC) महाराष्ट्र में किस बंदरगाह पर समाप्त होता है?
options_en: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust (JNPT, Navi Mumbai)
options_hi: जवाहरलाल नेहरू पोर्ट ट्रस्ट (JNPT, नवी मुंबई)
mcqs.explanation_en: The Western DFC runs from Dadri in UP to JNPT in Navi Mumbai.
mcqs.explanation_hi: वेस्टर्न डीएफसी दादरी (उत्तर प्रदेश) से जेएनपीटी (नवी मुंबई) तक जाता है।

mcqs.question_en: Which international developmental agency provided prime funding for the Western DFC?
mcqs.question_hi: वेस्टर्न डीएफसी के निर्माण हेतु प्रमुख वित्तीय ऋण किस अंतरराष्ट्रीय विकास एजेंसी ने प्रदान किया?
mcqs.explanation_en: JICA funded the Western DFC, while the World Bank funded portions of the Eastern DFC.
mcqs.explanation_hi: वेस्टर्न डीएफसी को जापान की एजेंसी 'जायका' (JICA) ने वित्तपोषित किया है।

mcqs.question_en: What is the maximum designed operational speed of freight trains on the Dedicated Freight Corridor tracks?
mcqs.question_hi: डेडिकेटेड फ्रेट कॉरिडोर पटरियों पर मालगाड़ियों की अधिकतम डिजाइन की गई परिचालन गति क्या है?
mcqs.explanation_en: Trains are designed to run at up to 100 km/h compared to the 25 km/h average on mixed tracks.
mcqs.explanation_hi: डीएफसी पटरियों पर मालगाड़ियां 100 किमी/घंटा की गति से दौड़ सकती हैं।

mcqs.question_en: In which year was the dedicated entity DFCCIL incorporated under the Companies Act?
mcqs.question_hi: कंपनी अधिनियम के तहत समर्पित इकाई DFCCIL की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
mcqs.explanation_en: DFCCIL was incorporated in October 2006.
mcqs.explanation_hi: DFCCIL की स्थापना अक्टूबर 2006 में की गई थी।

articles.summary: The State Cabinet of Chhattisgarh has accorded formal administrative approval to 'Deepti Yojana', a pioneering women empowerment initiative in the clean energy transition. Implemented by the Chhattisgarh State Renewable Energy Development Agency (CREDA) along with the Panchayat and Rural Development Department, the scheme trains rural self-help group (SHG) women as 'Surya Sakhis'. These women are deployed to assemble, maintain, and manage decentralized solar home systems, solar irrigation pumps, and biomass briquette micro-enterprises, earning sustainable monthly incomes while driving rural decarbonization.

articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) rolled out an investor education initiative titled 'Samajh Se Investing Simple' under its flagship 'Project Jagrook'. Targeting first-time retail investors, students, and gig-economy workers, the campaign combats financial misinformation peddled by unregistered 'finfluencers' and fraudulent online trading groups. The initiative promotes systematic investment planning (SIPs), mandates risk disclosures on high-risk futures and options (F&O) trading, and popularizes SEBI's digital grievance redressal mechanism SCORES 2.0 and the SMART ODR portal.

articles.summary: To enhance rural livelihoods and empower youth in tribal and remote pockets, the Koriya District Administration in Chhattisgarh deployed a fleet of specialized 'Mission Kamyabi' mobile skilling vans funded by NITI Aayog's Aspirational Districts Programme. Flagged off by the state government, each mobile van serves as a traveling training laboratory fitted with solar power, multimedia screens, and modern workshop toolkits. The initiative delivers certified short-term modular skilling in mobile repairing, solar panel assembly, organic food processing, and modern agri-machinery repair directly in village panchayats.

articles.summary: The Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant administered the oath of office to three newly appointed Supreme Court judges at the Supreme Court auditorium in New Delhi. The appointments, cleared by the President of India on the recommendation of the Supreme Court Collegium, take the working strength of the apex court to 37 judges, against its maximum sanctioned constitutional strength of 38. The addition of new judges aims to tackle heavy pendency, ensure the expeditious functioning of Constitution Benches, and reduce delays in criminal appeals and civil special leave petitions.
articles.title_hi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीशों की संख्या बढ़कर 37 हुई, मुख्य न्यायाधीश सूर्यकांत ने 3 नए जजों को दिलाई शपथ
articles.history_hi: मूल संविधान में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में मुख्य न्यायाधीश सहित केवल 8 न्यायाधीशों का प्रावधान था। समय-समय पर संसद द्वारा कानून पारित कर इसकी संख्या बढ़ाई गई, जिसे 2019 के बाद चरणबद्ध रूप से 38 तक स्वीकृत किया गया।
articles.historicalContext: Under the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Act, 2019, the sanctioned strength of the apex court was increased from 31 to 34 (including CJI), which was subsequently expanded to 38.

The addition of new judges aims to tackle heavy pendency, ensure the expeditious functioning of Constitution Benches, and reduce delays in criminal appeals and civil special leave petitions.

mcqs.question_en: Under which Article of the Constitution of India are Supreme Court judges appointed by the President?
mcqs.question_hi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत राष्ट्रपति द्वारा सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीशों की नियुक्ति की जाती है?
mcqs.explanation_en: Article 124(2) provides for the appointment of Supreme Court judges by the President.
mcqs.explanation_hi: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 124(2) के तहत सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीशों की नियुक्ति होती है।

mcqs.question_en: What is the mandatory retirement age for a Judge of the Supreme Court of India?
mcqs.question_hi: भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश की अनिवार्य सेवानिवृत्ति आयु क्या है?
mcqs.explanation_en: Supreme Court judges hold office until they attain the age of 65 years.
mcqs.explanation_hi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश 65 वर्ष की आयु पूरी होने पर सेवानिवृत्त होते हैं।

mcqs.question_en: How many senior-most judges constitute the Supreme Court Collegium along with the CJI for recommending apex court appointments?
mcqs.question_hi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में न्यायाधीशों की नियुक्ति की सिफारिश हेतु सीजेआई के अलावा कितने वरिष्ठतम न्यायाधीश कॉलेजियम का हिस्सा होते हैं?
mcqs.explanation_en: The Supreme Court Collegium consists of the CJI and 4 senior-most judges of the Court.
mcqs.explanation_hi: शीर्ष अदालत के कॉलेजियम में सीजेआई और 4 वरिष्ठतम न्यायाधीश (कुल 5 सदस्य) शामिल होते हैं।

mcqs.question_en: Who has the constitutional power under Article 124(1) to increase the number of judges in the Supreme Court?
mcqs.question_hi: अनुच्छेद 124(1) के तहत सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में न्यायाधीशों की संख्या बढ़ाने की संवैधानिक शक्ति किसके पास है?
mcqs.explanation_en: Only Parliament has the authority to increase the strength of Supreme Court judges by enacting legislation.

articles.summary: The United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) officially adopted the 'United Nations Convention Against Cybercrime', concluding over five years of multilateral negotiations. Marking the world's first global, legally binding treaty dedicated specifically to countering cyber-enabled offenses, the convention establishes cross-border mutual legal assistance mechanisms for intercepting online child sexual abuse material (CSAM), ransomware attacks, money laundering in virtual digital assets, and critical information infrastructure attacks. The convention provides an inclusive framework for developing nations and the Global South compared to regional instruments like the 2001 Budapest Convention.
articles.title_hi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा (UNGA) ने ऐतिहासिक व्यापक अंतरराष्ट्रीय साइबर अपराध संधि को दी औपचारिक मंजूरी
articles.history_hi: इससे पूर्व 2001 की बुडापेस्ट संधि साइबर अपराध का मुख्य अंतरराष्ट्रीय ढांचा थी, लेकिन भारत सहित कई विकासशील देशों ने संप्रभुता और डेटा पहुंच की चिंताओं के कारण इस पर हस्ताक्षर नहीं किए थे।
articles.historicalContext: Prior to this UN-wide instrument, the primary international pact was the Council of Europe's 2001 Budapest Convention on Cybercrime, which India and several developing countries declined to sign due to data sovereignty concerns.

Marking the world's first global, legally binding treaty dedicated specifically to countering cyber-enabled offenses, the convention establishes cross-border mutual legal assistance mechanisms for intercepting online child sexual abuse material (CSAM), ransomware attacks, money laundering in virtual digital assets, and critical information infrastructure attacks. The convention provides an inclusive framework for developing nations and the Global South compared to regional instruments like the 2001 Budapest Convention.

articles.summary: The Sports and Youth Welfare Department of Chhattisgarh in coordination with the Home Department commenced the registrations and block-level rounds of 'Bastar Olympics 2026'. Expanding from the initial 7 districts of Bastar division to cover 10 tribal-dominated districts, the multi-tier sporting event aims to channel youth potential, build peace, and counter left-wing extremism. Featuring traditional tribal games like Gedi दौड़ and Kabaddi alongside Olympic sports like Archery, Athletics, and Football, the event adopted the state animal (Wild Buffalo - Van Bhainsa) and state bird (Hill Myna - Pahadi Maina) as its official mascots under the Gondi slogan 'Karsay Ta Bastar'.

articles.details: The State Cabinet of Chhattisgarh has approved the comprehensive 'Chhattisgarh Industrial Policy 2024-2029', aiming to drive industrial diversification, attract eco-friendly green investments, and generate employment across all 33 districts. The policy prioritizes high-thrust sectors including Food Processing, Information Technology (IT/ITeS), Renewable Energy Equipment, Core Steel Downstream Units, Mineral-based value addition, and Herbal Processing. articles.summary: Nagarnar village in Bastar district, home to the NMDC Nagarnar Integrated Steel Plant (NISP), has been officially designated as Bastar division's first 'Model Solar Village'. Under the joint initiative of the District Administration, CREDA, and NMDC, over 1.2 MW of distributed rooftop solar panels, solar microgrids, solar-powered drinking water filtration plants, and smart solar LED street lighting have been deployed. The initiative transforms the village into a net-zero energy community, serving as a replicable blueprint for industrial green transitions across tribal areas of Chhattisgarh.

articles.details: India observed National Engineers' Day on September 15 to commemorate the 165th birth anniversary of the legendary civil engineer, statesman, and Bharat Ratna recipient Sir Mokshagundam Visvesvaraya. Celebrated across premier engineering institutes, CSIR labs, and infrastructure bodies, the day focused on the theme of 'Engineering for Sustainable and Resilient Infrastructure'. Sir Visvesvaraya is revered for inventing automatic water floodgates installed at Khadakwasla reservoir, designing the Krishna Raja Sagara Dam in Mysuru, and formulating the block system of irrigation.
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi approved a landmark commitment of ₹10,000 crore to establish the Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) Growth Fund (SGF). The fund will provide direct equity and quasi-equity capital to high-growth MSMEs to help them scale into global champions. Concurrently, the Cabinet cleared the creation of the Indian Transport and Logistics Agency (ITLA), tasked with formulating a 10-year integrated National Transport Master Plan and conducting mandatory technical and economic appraisals for central infrastructure projects costing ₹500 crore or more.

articles.summary: The Home Department of Chhattisgarh launched the upgraded 'Next-Gen CG Dial-112 Phase-2' emergency response support system along with a fleet of mobile forensic crime investigation vans. Integrated with advanced Geographic Information System (GIS) mapping, GPS fleet tracking, and real-time distress video uplinking, the modernized system slashes average emergency response times to under 15 minutes in urban centers and 25 minutes in rural areas. The mobile forensic vans are equipped with portable DNA sampling kits, automated fingerprint identifiers, and ballistic analysis tools to collect forensic evidence at crime scenes immediately.

articles.summary: The Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) officially notified an expanded schedule of permissible rural works under the 'Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)' [VB-G RAM G] Act, 2025. The total number of eligible community and individual works has been increased from 266 to 375, marking a 41% expansion. The expanded list covers four core thematic pillars: water security and climate resilience, rural infrastructure and value chains, individual livelihood augmentation for SC/ST and women farmers, and disaster mitigation works in flood- and drought-prone regions.

mcqs.question_en: To what total number has the Ministry of Rural Development expanded the permissible works under VB-G RAM G?
mcqs.question_hi: ग्रामीण विकास मंत्रालय ने VB-G RAM G के तहत अनुमेय कार्यों की कुल संख्या बढ़ाकर कितनी कर दी है?
mcqs.explanation_en: The schedule of permissible works was expanded from 266 to 375 works.
mcqs.explanation_hi: अनुमेय ग्रामीण कार्यों की संख्या को 266 से बढ़ाकर 375 कर दिया गया है।

mcqs.question_en: By what approximate percentage did the permissible works increase following the notification?
mcqs.question_hi: हालिया अधिसूचना के बाद अनुमेय कार्यों की संख्या में लगभग कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई है?
mcqs.explanation_en: The growth from 266 to 375 constitutes a 41% expansion in eligible rural works.
mcqs.explanation_hi: 266 से 375 कार्यों की यह बढ़ोतरी 41% की वृद्धि दर्शाती है।

mcqs.question_en: Which grassroots constitutional institution is mandated to recommend and approve permissible works locally?
mcqs.question_hi: स्थानीय स्तर पर अनुमेय कार्यों की सिफारिश और अनुमोदन करने का अधिकार किस संवैधानिक निकाय को है?
mcqs.explanation_en: The Gram Sabha holds constitutional authority to prioritize and approve annual works.
mcqs.explanation_hi: ग्राम सभा को स्थानीय स्तर पर कार्यों का चयन और अनुमोदन करने का प्राथमिक अधिकार है।

mcqs.question_en: In which year was the original Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act enacted?
mcqs.question_hi: मूल महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम (MGNREGA) किस वर्ष पारित किया गया था?
mcqs.explanation_en: The landmark MGNREGA legislation was passed by Parliament in 2005.
mcqs.explanation_hi: मनरेगा अधिनियम संसद द्वारा वर्ष 2005 में पारित किया गया था।

mcqs.question_en: Which of the following is NOT one of the primary pillars under the expanded rural works framework?
mcqs.question_hi: विस्तारित ग्रामीण कार्य ढांचे के तहत निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक प्राथमिक स्तंभ नहीं है?
options_en: Individual livelihood augmentation for small farmers
options_hi: छोटे किसानों के लिए व्यक्तिगत आजीविका संवर्धन
mcqs.explanation_en: Commercial mall development is outside the scope of rural guaranteed public works.
mcqs.explanation_hi: व्यावसायिक मॉल निर्माण ग्रामीण रोजगार कार्यों के दायरे में शामिल नहीं है।
